== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The 2006 slip adds creatures to the free-fire target choice. Deployment on Han except TK-422 as a react, destiny plus one against defense, the hit and zero-forfeit results, opponent’s 1 Force loss, and the once-per-control-phase shot using 1 Force remain. The revised sentence expresses the three hit consequences in one list. Holotable announced corrected images in July 2005. Its maintainer cited changed PC text or possible use of an older file, and the separate corrections page identifies an outdated PDF. The earliest complete correction wording located is on the 2006 publisher slip. The checked 2006 publisher slip and the 2007 PC-hosted image agree.
